item.title: Fed’s Powell says Trump administration has threatened him with a criminal indictment
item.description: WASHINGTON (Reuters) — The Trump administration has threatened to indict Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell over Congressional testimony he gave last summer about a Fed building project, an action Powell called a "pretext" to gain more influence over the central bank and monetary policy. item.title: NMPASI office closed on Jan. 19
item.description: (NMPASI) — The Northern Marianas Protection & Advocacy Systems, Inc office will be closed on Monday, Jan. 19, 2026 in observance of Martin Luther King Jr. Day. Regular office hours will resume on Tuesday, Jan. 20, 2026. The post NMPASI office closed on Jan. 19 appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: Rota SBDC to host no-cost federal contracting training
item.description: ROTA (SBDC) — The Rota Small Business Development Center will host a no-cost Federal Contracting Training on Jan. 13 and Jan. 14, 2026, at the NMC Rota Center, Computer Lab. Both days will offer the same training, allowing participants to select the date that works best for their schedule. item.title: Family files wrongful-death lawsuit against CHCC
item.description: THE family of a 64‑year‑old woman who died on Feb. 9, 2024, after a fall and rapid medical decline at the local hospital, has filed a wrongful‑death lawsuit in Superior Court, accusing the Commonwealth Healthcare Corp. of negligence and failing to provide adequate care. item.title: CPUC sets deadline for CUC to pay net-metering credits
item.description: THE Commonwealth Public Utilities Commission is putting the Commonwealth Utilities Corp. on notice after determining that CUC has failed for years to comply with a CNMI law requiring annual reconciliation and partial payout of customer net-metering credits.
